lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਓਨੑਾ ਮਿਹਰ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat tere daiaal onhaa mihar paai ||
lines.translation: O Merciful Lord, You bless Your devotees with Your Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਡ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh darad vad rog na pohe tis maai ||
lines.translation: Suffering, pain, terrible disease and Maya do not afflict them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa ehu adhaar gun govi(n)d gaai ||
lines.translation: This is the Support of the devotees, that they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa din rain iko ik dhiaai ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, day and night, they meditate on the One and Only Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਵਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: peevat a(n)mrit naam jan naame rahe aghaai ||14||
lines.translation: Drinking in the Ambrosial Amrit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, His humble servants remain satisfied with the Naam. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot bighan tis laagate jis no visarai naau ||
lines.translation: Millions of obstacles stand in the way of one who forgets the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਪਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak anadin bilapate jiu su(n)njai ghar kaau ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, night and day, he croaks like a raven in a deserted house. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: piree milaavaa jaa theeai saaee suhaavee rut ||
lines.translation: Beauteous is that season, when I am united with my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵੀਐ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ghaRee muhat nah veesarai naanak raveeai nit ||2||
lines.translation: I do not forget Him for a moment or an instant; O Nanak, I contemplate Him constantly. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਵਰੀਆਮ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: soorabeer vareeaam kinai na hoReeai ||
lines.translation: Even brave and mighty men cannot withstand the powerful

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਉਜ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਹਾਠ ਪੰਚਾ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: phauj sataanee haath pa(n)chaa joReeai ||
lines.translation: And overwhelming army which the five passions have gathered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਦੇਨਿ ਚਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: das naaree audhoot den chamoReeai ||
lines.translation: The ten organs of sensation attach even detached renunciates to sensory pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਣਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਲੈਨੑਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਏਹੋ ਏਨਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jin lainhi ralaai eho enaa loReeai ||
lines.translation: They seek to conquer and overpower them, and so increase their following.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun in kai vas kinai na moReeai ||
lines.translation: The world of the three dispositions is under their influence; no one can stand against them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਖਾਈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam kot maaiaa khaaee kahu kit bidh toReeai ||
lines.translation: So tell me - how can the fort of doubt and the moat of Maya be overcome?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਦਲੁ ਫੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa aaraadh bikham dal phoReeai ||
lines.translation: Worshipping the Perfect Guru, this awesome force is subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: hau tis agai din raat rahaa kar joReeai ||15||
lines.translation: I stand before Him, day and night, with my palms pressed together. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭੇ ਉਤਰਨਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kilavikh sabhe utaran neet neet gun gaau ||
lines.translation: All sins are washed away, by continually singing the Lord's Glories.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸਾ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot kalesaa oopajahi naanak bisarai naau ||1||
lines.translation: Millions of afflictions are produced, O Nanak, when the Name is forgotten. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur bhetiai pooree hovai jugat ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, one comes to know the Perfect Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸੰਦਿਆ ਖੇਲੰਦਿਆ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਖਾਵੰਦਿਆ ਵਿਚੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hasa(n)diaa khela(n)diaa paina(n)diaa khaava(n)diaa viche hovai mukat ||2||
lines.translation: While laughing, playing, dressing and eating, he is liberated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮ ਗੜੁ ਤੋੜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satigur dhan dha(n)n jin bharam gaR toRiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has demolished the fortress of doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਜੋੜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so satigur vaahu vaahu jin har siu joRiaa ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! - Hail! Hail! to the True Guru, who has united me with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan akhut gur dei daarooo ||
lines.translation: The Guru has given me the medicine of the inexhaustible treasure of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਤਿਨੈ ਬਿਦਾਰੂਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa rog bikaraal tinai bidaarooo ||
lines.translation: He has banished the great and terrible disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaiaa naam nidhaan bahut khajaaniaa ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the great treasure of the wealth of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jitaa janam apaar aap pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: I have obtained eternal life, recognizing my own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahimaa kahee na jaai gur samarath dev ||
lines.translation: The Glory of the all-powerful Divine Guru cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur paarabraham paramesur apara(n)par alakh abhev ||16||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, infinite, unseen and unknowable. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਮਾਵਦਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam karediaa jeeu too(n) kamaavadiaa sukh bhu(n)ch ||
lines.translation: Make the effort, and you shall live; practicing it, you shall enjoy peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਰੀ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhiaaidiaa too(n) prabhoo mil naanak utaree chi(n)t ||1||
lines.translation: Meditating, you shall meet God, O Nanak, and your anxiety shall vanish. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)d raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Bless me with sublime thoughts, O Lord of the Universe, and contemplation in the immaculate Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for even an instant; be merciful to me, Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa keetaa hoi ta kaahe darapeeai ||
lines.translation: Whatever happens is according to Your Will, so why should I be afraid?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis mil japeeai naau tis jeeu arapeeai ||
lines.translation: Meeting Him, I meditate on the Name - I offer my soul to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiai chit nihaal saahib besumaar ||
lines.translation: When the Infinite Lord comes to mind, one is enraptured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੋਹੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis no pohe kavan jis val nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: Who can touch one who has the Formless Lord on his side?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh tis kai vas na koee baaharaa ||
lines.translation: Everything is under His control; no one is beyond Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so bhagataa man vuthaa sach samaaharaa ||
lines.translation: He, the True Lord, dwells in the minds of His devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere daas dhiaain tudh too(n) rakhan vaaliaa ||
lines.translation: Your slaves meditate on You; You are the Savior, the Protector Lord.
